_comment: Reviewed license inventory for every Python distribution that may be installed in a
Wavebit validation, documentation or packaging environment. tools/check_licenses.py
compares installed metadata against it. Add a reviewed entry before adding a dependency;
a missing entry fails the check. Human-readable table: docs/development/third-party.md.
external_tools and bundled are not installed by pip; the check requires the docs to list them.

rules: runtime (base requirements of wavebit, transitively): permissive only
optional (wavebit extras): permissive, or weak copyleft when the entry sets weak_copyleft_review (unmodified, installed separately by pip, never bundled or loaded directly)

tool (installed but not required: test runners, CI tools, external_tools a test environment installs): any license but never, GPL and AGPL included, since tools never ship; each still needs a reviewed entry, and an AGPL one an agpl_review note (unmodified upstream release, unshipped use only, never in a hosted service)
GPL: never imported, linked or bundled by src/wavebit and never a requirement; unshipped tests, studies and reference scripts may run GPL tools, skipping when they are absent
never (SSPL and other non-AGPL network copyleft): rejected in every environment; shipped_never (AGPL): rejected for runtime, optional and external-process use, accepted for tools

bundled_files: every shared library a third-party distribution installs, other than its own Python extension modules, must match a glob recorded for the current OS; a record needs a review unless its expression is satisfied by permissive plus bundled_permissive and names no copyleft license; these libraries load into the Wavebit process, so a GPL term passes only with a listed runtime exception or inside an OR with another option; Wavebit's own distribution contains no native files

Meep.use: FDTD reference solver run in its own interpreter; frozen numbers in tests/references/

S4.use: RCWA reference solver run in its own interpreter; frozen numbers in tests/references/

Octave.use: runs RETICOLO as a separate process driven by oct2py

RETICOLO.use: RCWA reference run inside Octave; not shipped

oct2py.use: Python driver for Octave in the RETICOLO comparisons

fmmax.use: RCWA reference in a separate environment

FDTDX.use: FDTD reference in a separate environment

PyMoosh.use: multilayer reference in a throwaway environment

NGSolve.use: optional FEM reference for NVF research studies; installed binaries also contain GPL-2.0-or-later UMFPACK code, so the environment is never redistributed

inkstone.use: black-box RCWA comparison (0.3.15, public API and returned numbers only, source never read); results cited in tests/references/README.md and docs/theory/rcwa/. No harness in this repository today
inkstone.agpl_review: unmodified upstream release from PyPI; may run only in unshipped tests or studies that skip without it; never imported by src/wavebit, never a requirement or extra, never in a hosted service

EMpy.use: past black-box comparison (ElectroMagneticPython 2.2.3) of anisotropic transfer matrices; results cited in tests/references/README.md and docs/theory/rcwa/

meent.use: origin of part of the RCWA code; notice in LICENSE and LICENSE.meent

fmmax-eig-bwd.use: eigendecomposition gradient ported into src/wavebit/_common/backend.py; notice in LICENSE and LICENSE.fmmax

refractiveindex-info.use: src/wavebit/data/refractiveindex/*.txt, shipped in the wheel and sdist; each table's publication is cited in that directory's README.md

certifi.weak_copyleft_review: Unmodified CA bundle installed by pip as a dependency of requests (Sphinx in the docs extra, and twine). Wavebit never imports, modifies or redistributes it.

docutils.metadata_review: The GPL classifier refers to files outside the wheel; COPYING.rst lists the shipped modules as public domain, BSD-2-Clause or 0BSD (eLyXer-derived files were relicensed to BSD-2-Clause). Reached through Sphinx (docs extra) and twine's README check.

jaxlib.bundled: jaxlib's own compiled modules (jaxlib/*.so, Python extension modules without a version tag, and libjax_common.so) statically contain the components whose licenses the wheel's LICENSE.txt reproduces: BoringSSL, gRPC, Abseil, Protocol Buffers, RE2, DLPack, double-conversion, Eigen (MPL-2.0, file-level weak copyleft, compiled by the wheel's publisher and used as shipped), Farmhash, FlatBuffers, HighwayHash, libjpeg-turbo, fft2d, giflib, LLVM (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception), oneDNN, nsync, TensorFlow, pybind11, snappy, upb and zlib. No separately built third-party library. Checked on Linux, jaxlib 0.11.2.

bundled_files.review: jaxlib's own compiled modules, loaded by jax; their static contents are listed under 'bundled'. Wavebit only calls jax's Python API and does not modify, relink or redistribute them.

matplotlib.review: PSF-based permissive license agreement; no SPDX identifier exists for it.
matplotlib.bundled: Extension modules statically include FreeType (FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later, FTL relied on), HarfBuzz (MIT-Modern-Variant), libraqm (MIT), SheenBidi (Apache-2.0) and Qhull (Qhull license); data files include fonts under OFL-1.1 (STIX, Last Resort), the BaKoMa Fonts Licence, Bitstream Vera terms (DejaVu) and Adobe AFM terms. No separate shared libraries.

numpy.spdx: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
numpy.bundled: Linux and macOS before 14: OpenBLAS with LAPACK (BSD-3-Clause, BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI), libgfortran (and libgcc_s on macOS; GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1) and libquadmath (LGPL-2.1-or-later, not covered by the GCC exception) as separate shared libraries. macOS 14 and later: nothing bundled (Apple Accelerate). Windows: OpenBLAS DLL with the GCC runtime and winpthreads (MIT AND BSD-3-Clause) statically linked, plus msvcp140.dll (Microsoft redistributable terms, no notice in the wheel).

bundled_files.review: GCC runtime under the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1; loaded by the wheel's own OpenBLAS or extension modules, not by Wavebit package code. Not redistributed.

libquadmath (LGPL-2.1-or-later, not covered by the GCC exception), a separate shared library loaded by the wheel's GCC runtime; the wheel's notice gives a URL but not the LGPL text. Wavebit does not modify, relink, load or redistribute it.

pillow.bundled: Linux and macOS: 18 image, font and compression libraries as separate shared libraries, all permissive per the wheel's notice; FreeType is FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later (FTL relied on); the xz section's LGPL/GPL text covers command-line tools that are not included, and its 'liblzma is in the public domain' line is pre-5.6 xz wording: the bundled xz 5.8 liblzma is 0BSD upstream. Windows: the same codecs statically linked into the extension modules. FriBiDi (LGPL) is not bundled; Pillow loads it at run time only if the system provides it.

scipy.bundled: Linux: OpenBLAS with LAPACK (BSD-3-Clause, BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI) and two builds each of libgfortran (GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1) and libquadmath (LGPL-2.1-or-later) as separate shared libraries. macOS (all versions): libgfortran, libgcc_s and libquadmath, plus OpenBLAS before macOS 14. Windows: OpenBLAS DLL with the GCC runtime and winpthreads statically linked; scipy/odr/__odrpack also statically contains GCC runtime code, very likely including libquadmath (byte-level match), and winpthreads appears in several extension modules; the wheel's notice mentions only the DLL. Qhull (Qhull license) is statically linked on every platform.
